name: commitment-advisor
description: Advises how much cloud commitment (savings plans, reserved instances) to buy and for how long, from hourly or daily usage you paste as CSV (timestamp or date, scope or instance_family, region, on_demand_cost) plus, optionally, your existing commitments after a line '--- commitments'. In code it sizes the hourly commit on a percentile grid at 95% minimum utilization, shows net savings per month and per term, utilization, break-even, coverage and a -20% usage downside with a risk class, compares 1 and 3 years, and says which existing commitments to renew more, renew the same, renew less or let lapse. Discounts are labelled assumptions (1y 25%, 3y 45%) until you give real quotes. Follow-ups: what if our 1y discount is 30%, should we go 3 years, min utilization 90%, compute only, as json. It purchases nothing and connects to no account.

skills.name: Commitment advice
skills.description: Recommends savings plan / reserved instance purchases and renewals from pasted cloud usage, with the savings, utilization, break-even and downside risk computed in code.
examples: Should we buy a savings plan? <paste usage>
Which commitments should we let lapse?
